_comment: Who may use the grocery list. Copy to members.json and edit; the real
file is gitignored because it holds personal phone numbers.
phone: E.164, with the country code and a leading +. This is the identity
used everywhere - membership, who added what, and language.
role:  owner or member. Owners are the people who may change the roster.
lang:  en or pt. The language replies come back in, which matters most
when someone just pastes a list and there is no prose to read.
The numbers here are fictional: US 555-0100..0199, Brazil 90000-00xx.
Apply with:  python3 grocery.py members sync
Revoke someone by deleting their entry and re-running with --prune.
